verified_behaviors: child process result is parsed and its content digest is verified
a child that exceeds the Java deadline is terminated and force-killed if needed
a digest mismatch is rejected instead of uploaded
structured child errors are surfaced to the worker
inline and child-process modes share the same engine implementation
limitations: This is process isolation, not a container/VM security sandbox
The child shares the host filesystem and network and inherits environment secrets
No container/VM capacity, cgroup or hostile-tenant isolation test was performed
No real model/provider call was made in this module
Java lease/deadline integration still needs real platform acceptance
